newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa says Apr-Oct data shows budget on-track.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa says Apr-Oct data shows budget on-track.

text.p: The South African finance department said on Friday that the government was on track to reached the estimated budget deficit of 5.1 percent of GDP before borrowing this year.
Total exchequer issues in the first seven months of the 1996/97 (April-March) financial year were 99.104 billion rand, or 57.1 percent of the year budget of 173.659 billion rand.
Total revenue for the same period was 84.926 billion rand, or 58.6 percent of the total budget of 144.9 billion.

"Exchquequer receipts for the financial year to date of some 58.6 percent of the estimated budgeted total are encouraging, given the fact that the receipts are traditionally slow in the first part of the financial year," the department said.
